definitions.explanation: Physical impact between two objects, especially vehicles.
Disagreement or opposition between people, groups, or ideas.

notes:
{衝突|しょうとつ} covers both physical collisions and abstract conflicts. Used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: ⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}する→衝突する：26785_shoutotsusuru⟧.

SENSE 1 — PHYSICAL COLLISION:
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧{衝突|しょうとつ}: head-on collision
- {衝突|しょうとつ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: collision accident
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}する→衝突する：26785_shoutotsusuru⟧: to collide with ~

SENSE 2 — ABSTRACT CONFLICT:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衝突|しょうとつ}: clash of opinions
- ⟦{利害|りがい}→利害：04091_rigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衝突|しょうとつ}: conflict of interest
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衝突|しょうとつ}: clash of cultures
- ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衝突|しょうとつ}: generational clash

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {衝突|しょうとつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid a collision/conflict
- {衝突|しょうとつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause a collision/conflict

SIMILAR WORDS:
{衝突|しょうとつ} implies forceful, sudden impact. For milder disagreements, ⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧ (opposition) is more appropriate.
